value.interpretation: Three declared steps in declared order: k0 ignite the lightsaber already held in the right hand (free object interaction); k1 move 10 ft to within reach of the near hound (hound_1), leaving no one's reach; k2 one lightsaber melee attack against hound_1 (the action). Blade held in the right hand only, left hand free and not declared on the hilt, so one-handed damage applies. The validator reports TURN_CONTINUES (20 ft movement and bonus slot unspent), so Aero's turn stays open; no other creature acts in this commit.
value.tables: k2 attack: 1d20+5 (sheet: lightsaber Dex attack +5) vs sim hound AC 12. Natural 20 critical (damage dice doubled). On hit: 1d8+3 energy (one-handed, sheet); hound HP 9, at 0 HP the construct winks out. On miss: no damage; hound unharmed. Damage is rolled only after a hit is established. No NPC decisions this submission: hound_1 does not act until its own turn; no reaction is triggered (Aero leaves no reach).
